scope: Production source review and bounded Metal correctness checks; no claimable full-model timing

engine/qwen35.js.boundary: _encMoeFfn, _encodeLayerBatch, prepared layer bindings, grouped prefill, conditional encode-ahead

confirmedFix.boundary: Qwen shared-expert scalar gate -> repeat_channels output
confirmedFix.before: 53 tokens * 2048 repeats dispatched [1,108544,1], violating the 65535 per-dimension limit. The same failure was reproduced locally before editing.
confirmedFix.after: One invocation per logical output element; two-dimensional linear workgroup tiling using explicit device limits and registry geometry.
confirmedFix.result: bit-exact F32 and F16 copies; immediate/recorded paths, tails and a forced real two-dimensional grid

consumer.limit: Synthetic bounded consumer fixture, not the complete 35B model or its full shared-expert dimensions

findings.finding: topk-readback waits for CPU route indices at each selected MoE layer. Opt-in topk-route bypasses that production scheduling readback; trace-only observation can still read back.
findings.next: Measure the selected route path on a fresh full-model correctness receipt before timing.

findings.finding: Routed experts still use four separate immediate kernel calls: gate/up projection, activation, down projection, weighted combine. Immediate dispatch builds and submits a command buffer per call.
findings.next: Provide a recorded route plan, then fuse gate/up with activation and down with combine; preserve storage interpretation, accumulation and deterministic route order.

findings.finding: The shared expert is separate from routed execution: gate, up, activation, down, scalar router, repeat, sigmoid multiplication and add. Pooled can place the shared expert in slot K of fused gate/up and down/combine kernels.
findings.next: Integrate explicit shared-expert bindings into a prepared MoE execution plan; avoid the expanded gate tensor. Preserve the independent shared sigmoid and router weight representation.

findings.finding: routeKernel ranks logits directly when renormalization is requested; gusKernel computes gate/up plus activation for routed and shared slots; dncKernel combines all routes plus shared output and residual.
findings.next: Use as a capability comparator; do not copy numerical changes or quantization assumptions into the Q4_K contract without independent evidence.

findings.finding: Pooled has expert-grouped prefill, whereas the new Doppler route projection executes each token/expert route independently.
findings.next: Measure repeated-expert weight traffic on prefill; add GPU grouping and a qualified grouped projection path if that traffic dominates.

findings.finding: Doppler has recorded adapters and coalesced compute passes, but the current Qwen routed/shared expert orchestration calls immediate adapters. Prepared bindings and persistent scratch need explicit lifetime ownership.
findings.next: Connect the existing recorders to the MoE plan; test cancellation, submission failure, reset, device loss and concurrent sessions before changing defaults.

findings.finding: Poolday consumes a pinned Doppler package (0.6.32), not live source changes in this checkout.
findings.next: After qualification, rebuild and install the exact package/artifact and verify runtime identity before claiming Poolday inherited these fixes.

comparisonLimits: The active 35B product comparison uses Pooled Q4_0 GGUF and Doppler Q4_K RDRR. It is not an equal-reconstructed-weight engine comparison.
The observed product run contained a repeat_channels failure and an unsuccessful arithmetic result; its timings cannot establish a successful service or engine win.
No amd-host GPU work was launched or stopped by this review; another session owned the full-model paired run.
Fused Pooled paths are capability- and layout-gated. Expert offload disables its ordinary encode-ahead; no unconditional 100 percent overlap claim is supported.
A 0.8B geometry or numerical result does not qualify the larger hybrid/MoE models.
acceptance: Fresh 35B correctness against pinned source weights and independent prefixes, including routed/shared outputs and later recurrent states
Trace actual selected shaders, submissions, host readbacks, allocations and phase-level CPU/GPU time
Separate prefill and decode experiments with fixed model, context, generation, weights and sampling
Complete-request distribution and first-token/delivery-gap results after correctness passes; no threshold changes after observing results
